turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Good morning Rosa, how have you been since the last visit?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Mostly fine. I have been more thirsty than usual and I get up at night to pass urine.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How is the metformin going, any stomach upset?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No problems, I take it with breakfast and dinner. I am nearly out and need a refill.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: We will sort the refill. Your blood pressure today reads better than at the intake.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I started walking every evening after dinner.

question: Draft the SOAP note for this visit and queue the metformin refill.
